name: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Columns / Container
description: Adds an 'EPT Columns / Container' Paragraphs type: a 1-to-6 column grid wrapper that nests other paragraphs, with per-layout column-width presets and equal-height, plus the EPT family's shared per-paragraph design settings.
project_description: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Columns / Container provides an 'ept_columns' Paragraphs bundle that lays other paragraphs out in a CSS-grid of one to six columns (one column = a plain container/section). The editor chooses a layout (1-6 columns) and, for two/three/four-column layouts, a column-width preset (e.g. 50/50, 33/67, 25/50/25, 25/25/25/25) plus an optional equal-height toggle; nested paragraphs are added into a repeatable Paragraphs reference field (field_ept_columns). The bundle also carries an optional title and text field and the EPT family's shared per-paragraph design settings (margin/padding/border, background color/image/video, edge-to-edge, container width) provided by ept_core. Layout choices are emitted as CSS classes on the wrapper and mapped to grid-template-columns by the shipped css/styles.css. Part of the EPT family built on ept_core and Paragraphs; install only the paragraph types you need.
